subject: general
question:
Find the median of the following data.

129.75, 116.6, 12.3, 114.1, 136.6, 118.7, 13.5, 121.3
solution:
**Calculation:**

To find median of the given data set, we have to arrange it in ascending order,

12.3, 13.5, 114.1, 116.6, 118.7, 121.3, 129.75, 136.6

Since there are 8 numbers, the median will be the average of the 4th and 5th number

Median = (116.6 + 118.7) / 2 = 235.3 / 2 = 117.65

∴ The correct answer is **117.65**
